_meta.purpose: Per-arch microbench baseline. Codec PRs gate against these numbers (>5% throughput regression blocks merge). Update by re-running the bench.

constant_int64_32MiB._note: Vectorised int4 store path; effectively L2/HBM write-bandwidth bound.

rle_long_runs_int64._note: 16 entries × 7680 rows per segment, 1092 segments. Cumsum fits in shmem; warp-vote broadcast fast path fires. Run-to-run variance ~15%.

rle_medium_runs_int64._note: 1024 entries × 120 rows per segment, 1092 segments. Cumsum (4 KiB) fits in shmem.

rle_pareto_runs_int64._note: Pareto-distributed run lengths (x_min=400 → ~100 entries/seg), 1092 segments. Realistic shape for sorted low-cardinality TPC-H columns.

rle_short_runs_int32_gmem._note: 4096 entries × 30 rows per segment. ec at the shmem cap; chunks where ec > RLE_SMEM_MAX_ENTRIES use the gmem-cumsum path.

uncompressed_multi_1024x32KiB_raw_memcpy._note: Reference only — dispatcher bypassed, per-segment cudaMemcpyAsync. Demonstrates why the batched kernel exists.

tunables._note: RLE_SMEM_MAX_ENTRIES caps per-CTA shmem cumsum cache at 16 KiB; chunks above this fall back to gmem-cumsum reads (L2 caches across CTAs of the same segment). RLE_BUILD_MAX_ENTRIES bounds the device-side cumsum allocation per segment; covers DuckDB's worst-case ec (~87K for T=int8 segments).
